state.background: The post-Phase6 Playwright residual run has three passing instances and seven skips. The normal advanced-series E2E is already covered by a production-route Browser Mode case. The only active mobile LazyMount E2E sets a test-only __MOUNT_ALL__ flag and has no expect; normal LazyMount is checked by unit and Browser Mode tests. Six accessibility tests are in describe.skip with no skip rationale: useful remaining predicates are dark legend presentation/hover reset, keyboard legend toggling, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion styling. The dark contrast-string truthiness check and range-picker locator-defined check are too weak to preserve. Tooltip #231 still has one useful active mobile open-state assertion; its removed post-wheel checks and other source deletions have unknown provenance and are explicitly out of scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a production-route Browser Mode suite covering four meaningful residual accessibility predicates with real assertions.
Retire only the already-covered advanced-series E2E and the no-assertion mobile LazyMount E2E, plus the six disabled accessibility tests after meaningful predicates are migrated.
Preserve tooltip #231 and avoid changes to unknown-provenance deletions.
Update the residual inventory, shared plan, and validation records without changing the original 33 Phase5 migration count.
verification: Existing final residual E2E log: 3 passed / 7 skipped.
Existing batch3-b Browser Mode test asserts normal and advanced production series, legends, and table contract.
Existing LazyMount unit and Browser Mode tests cover the mount override and normal lazy behavior.
Accessibility source inspection found six unconditional skipped tests and no skip reason.
Local Next.js Playwright guide read before planning changes.
knownConstraints: Do not restore or remove source deleted in changes of unknown provenance.
The four new residual accessibility checks remain separate from the original 33 Phase5 cutovers.
Tests, lint, TypeScript, and Browser Mode validation remain required independently of JEV.
state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For a reason choice, give a case-specific finding, affected location or requirement, observed evidence, and either a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

plan.instructions: Does the plan make a sufficiently supported and correctly scoped decision about the residual E2E cases? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The plan is supported by the audit evidence and respects the stated unknown-provenance boundaries.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A planned disposition conflicts with the intended migration requirements; identify the exact case and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A specific additional requirement or decision is needed before the planned disposition can be chosen.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The plan lacks a specific detail needed to execute or validate a disposition.
criteria.implementation_issue: A planned method or test approach is technically unsound; identify its location and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The plan changes cases beyond its stated audit scope; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material case-specific concern does not fit the categories; identify its location and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The evidence is insufficient to judge the plan; identify exactly what is missing.
